title: Derivation of keys at CS to PS SRVCC handover from A/Gb mode to S1 mode or from Iu mode to S1 mode

entities.name: CS to PS SRVCC handover
entities.description: Handover procedure from Circuit Switched domain to Packet Switched domain using Single Radio Voice Call Continuity, specifically from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode.

entities.name: Mapped EPS security context
entities.description: Security context derived for EPS from UMTS CS domain security context during SRVCC handover, containing K'ASME and associated keys.

entities.name: K'ASME
entities.description: Access Security Management Entity key derived by concatenating CK'PS and IK'PS (CK'PS || IK'PS) during SRVCC handover.

entities.name: CK'PS
entities.description: Cipher key for PS domain derived from CS UMTS ciphering key and NONCEMSC during SRVCC handover.

entities.name: IK'PS
entities.description: Integrity key for PS domain derived from CS UMTS integrity key and NONCEMSC during SRVCC handover.

entities.name: KSISGSN
entities.description: Key Set Identifier for SGSN domain, set to KSI'PS value during SRVCC handover and associated with K'ASME.

entities.name: NONCEMSC
entities.description: Nonce created by MSC and used in derivation of CK'PS and IK'PS during SRVCC handover.

entities.name: EPS NAS keys
entities.description: NAS security keys (CK' and IK') derived from K'ASME and applied after successful SRVCC handover.

entities.name: Handover completed successfully
entities.description: Condition where CS to PS SRVCC handover from A/Gb mode or Iu mode has been completed successfully, triggering security context replacement.

entities.name: Handover not completed successfully
entities.description: Condition where CS to PS SRVCC handover from A/Gb mode or Iu mode has not been completed successfully, triggering security context deletion.

relations.description: CS to PS SRVCC handover procedure establishes a mapped EPS security context for the PS domain.
Mapped EPS security context contains K'ASME as its primary key component.
K'ASME is formed by concatenating CK'PS and IK'PS (CK'PS || IK'PS).
K'ASME is formed by concatenating CK'PS and IK'PS (CK'PS || IK'PS).
Mapped EPS security context is associated with KSISGSN identifier.
K'ASME is used to derive EPS NAS keys (CK' and IK') for security protection.
Successful handover completion establishes the mapped EPS security context replacement procedure.
Unsuccessful handover completion establishes the deletion of the mapped EPS security context.
EPS NAS keys provide integrity protection and ciphering for the mapped EPS security context.
